original_target.title: Polynomial equilibration at the four-state planar Potts critical point

problem_statement: On the nearest-neighbor torus $`V_n=(\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z)^2`$, $`n\ge3`$, let $`\pi_n(\sigma)\propto\exp((\log3)\sum_{xy\in E_n}\mathbf1_{\sigma_x=\sigma_y})`$ for $`\sigma\in\{1,2,3,4\}^{V_n}`$. At each vertex, independently at rate one, resample its color from the conditional law under $`\pi_n`$. Let $`t_{\rm mix}(n)=\inf\{t:\max_\sigma\|\mathcal L_\sigma(\sigma_t)-\pi_n\|_{\rm TV}\le1/4\}`$. Do finite constants $`C,a>0`$ exist with $`t_{\rm mix}(n)\le Cn^a`$ for every $`n`$?
recommendation: Retain Open for exact target; bounded searches found no full match, not a certification of openness.
